concepts.label: N1 NCE + four parallel books
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: preview-only iOS icon concept for an offline New Concept English FOUR-VOLUME learning app, suitable for Chinese/Japanese/Korean storefronts.
Primary request: The icon MUST simultaneously communicate the exact name "NCE" AND the complete set of four books. The previous book-only and letters-only designs were rejected. Do NOT separate these ideas into different options.
Presentation: one square white design board, about 1024x1024. A single large iOS-mask rounded-square icon centered with generous white margin, and one smaller copy of EXACTLY the same design below. The only heading above the icon is the identifier specified below. No phone mockup, no cover mockups, no explanatory text.
Required icon text: "NCE" in large clear uppercase Latin letters, plus the exact Arabic numbers "1", "2", "3", "4", one on each of exactly FOUR books in order. No other wording. Text must be correctly spelled and entirely readable. "NCE" is the first glance signal, but the four books must remain recognizable as four separate complete volumes.
Style: original polished editorial brand illustration, mature adult education app, simplified ink shapes with subtle human hand-drawn character. Match an approved cover series of airy white paperback covers, charcoal line drawings and burgundy, teal, blue, gold accents. Icon details must be bolder and far simpler than cover illustrations. Flat print illustration with restrained paper-like warmth, not a thin scribbly doodle.
Constraints: preserve both NCE and ALL FOUR volumes in large and small previews. No Chinese, Japanese or Korean writing; no flags, headphone imagery, speech bubbles, flowers, publisher names, famous logos, copyright marks or watermarks. No shiny inflated clay, plastic 3D, photorealistic rendering, decorative badge, star, tiny subtitle or dense page lines. Not a generic app symbol. Four books are the product; do not substitute four squares, page tabs or abstract dots.
Board heading exact "N1".
Icon composition: rich deep teal solid field. Top third has a large bold warm-white serif "NCE", one centered line, not touching edges. Lower half contains EXACTLY FOUR complete small upright front-facing paperback books, side by side, even-width, same height, almost touching but with four obvious gaps. Each book has a warm-white cover with a single thin charcoal spine line and a broad solid color panel occupying the bottom 60 percent: burgundy, teal, blue, gold from left to right. Each panel carries one large clear warm-white numeral: 1, 2, 3, 4. No other text on books. Their upper white areas remain blank. Four coordinated actual book silhouettes, not rounded UI tiles. Book row occupies 78 percent of icon width, NCE occupies 66 percent. Good breathing room between NCE and book row. No perspective, no shadows, no decorative borders. Simple strong hierarchy: NCE, then four-volume series.
